limitations.text: Free plans can add one custom connector.
On Team and Enterprise only Owners add custom connectors, and each member connects separately.
The server must be reachable from Anthropic's outbound range 160.79.104.0/21 over IPv4; hostnames with only AAAA records fail.
Private, loopback and CGNAT addresses are rejected, including mixed public/private DNS answers.
OAuth discovery, registration and token endpoints must answer within 10 seconds (refresh: 30 seconds).
Sign-in starts only from a 401; PKCE S256 is required; only the first authorization_servers entry is used.
A cross-host redirect of the server URL drops the Authorization header.
Authentication settings cannot be edited after the connector is saved.
Tool calls time out after 240 seconds; results are capped at about 150,000 characters.
Private networks are reachable only through MCP tunnels, an Enterprise research preview.
